note: A DH object is created through the engine-specific constructor path, so the chosen engine controls whether a DH_METHOD is installed.
The constructor stores the engine-provided DH_METHOD pointer, which may remain NULL when the engine lacks DH support.
The safety obligation is that the free path must not dereference a missing method; the check must ensure the method pointer is valid before using it.
When the guard is absent or ineffective, freeing the partially initialized DH object dereferences the method pointer and triggers the crash/use-after-free path.
